Only useful when the snapshot has a pet section; otherwise it says what is missing.
--- message[0] role=user ---
Assess the pet's state and say what to improve. Check happiness (happiness) and loyalty, how many training points are left (trainingPoints; if they are not in the data, say the addon did not save them) and whether the pet has auto-cast enabled where it is useful (autoCast). The game client itself said which bag food this pet can eat (bagFood.edible, bagFood.refused): give how many feedings it lasts (bagFood.feedings) and which food it refuses; do not second-guess the client's verdict. If there is beastTraining, point out the ranks to buy with the free points. From rankReview give the ranks the Hunter knows that the pet lacks (learnable), and the ranks to buy from the trainer (notLearnedByHunter); from trainingPlan, what fits into the free points; from whereToTame, which observed beasts have ranks the Hunter does not know (hunterKnows = no first), with their zone, level and coordinates, saying plainly that these come only from beasts this account tamed or examined with Beast Lore in Forever (whereToTame.source); when it has no ranks, relay its note on how to collect them and do not name beasts or zones from memory; from stable compare the stabled pets with the active one (level, family), remembering that there is no data on their abilities. When a field says data is missing, say which window to open in game. Do not give numbers that are not in the data.

Answer in the language the user writes in; keep the names of spells, items, quests and places in English, as they appear in the game. Rely on the data below; if something is missing from it, say which window the player should open in game and then type /mcp reload. You only advise: do not propose macros or addons that play for the player.
